If you play "Monopoly 200X" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.

762.body:
The most common win left on "Billion" is $100. The second biggest prize left is $1 million, and 41 of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Billion's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

Tomorrow's count on "Billion" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" has had no $15 million top prize claimed for over a month. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

If "50th Anniversary" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
